notes: v3 combat and expedition layer, final tuning: normal hostile health 16 + 5 × floor + 13 × stage, guardian health 67 / 96 / 132 (Regent / Hollow Choir / Blackout Core). 150 deterministic seeds per archetype and policy; four lightweight bots (careless, aggressive, adaptive, tactical) play every room of all three stages, including market, events and sanctuary via scripts/bot-meta.ts. These are regression probes, not human difficulty or enjoyment measurements.

current.notes: v3 deterministic bots, default routing, ascension 0. Regression probes, not a human difficulty estimate.

eliteSeeking.notes: v3 deterministic bots, elite-seeking routing, ascension 0. Regression probes, not a human difficulty estimate.

ascension5.notes: v3 deterministic bots, default routing, ascension 5. Regression probes, not a human difficulty estimate.

ascension10.notes: v3 deterministic bots, default routing, ascension 10. Regression probes, not a human difficulty estimate.

experiments.notes: 150 seeds per archetype, tactical policy, ascension 0, before the shipped guardian health change (base guardians 56/80/110). Used to choose the final numbers; not the shipped state.
